title: Run mein hawa ke
body:
ran mein hawa ke jhonke nauha suna rahe hai
chaliye hussain chaliye qasim bula rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar madad ko aao naushah e karbala ki
gulgoon badan pe ghode daudaye jaa rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein mile to kaise qasim ki laash unko
abbas kko shahe deen tukde dikha rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye karbala ki shadi dunya se hai niraali
mehman sab baraati pyase hi aa rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadi thi pal ki lekin sadiyon pe chayi dekho
ab tak zamane waale mehendi utha rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
taqseem ho chuke thay is darja ran mein qasim
sarwar abaa bicha kar laasha utha rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye karbala ka dulha ran mein shabab par tha
qasim ko dunya waale dulha bana rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kubra ye keh rahi hai ye kaisi qayamat hai
dulhan bana ke hum ko bewa bana rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti hussain ki hoon aur hoon bahu hassan ki
phir bhi ye aada hum ko dar dar phira rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
daste hinaayi dekho paband hai rasan ki
zewar ke badle zaalim bedi pinha rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bewa ye keh rahi hai kuch meri khabar le lo
dekho ye ahle kufa hum ko sata rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
nusrat mein shaahe deen ki iqbal dekho qasim
pyase hi aaye ran mein pyase hi jaa rahe hai
ran mein hawa ke...
author: Iqbal Abedi
